error.metrics_unreachable: Telemetry endpoint not reachable. Is telemetry.metrics enabled and the port reachable from Home Assistant?
error.metrics_invalid: The endpoint answers but provides no Authelia metrics. If Authelia was just restarted, sign in once and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Authelia instance is already configured.

data_description.installed_version: Only needed without agent, e.g. 4.39.27. Enables the update entity.
data_description.agent_url: Optional. URL of the Authelia HA Agent, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:9960. Adds bans, login history with user and IP, and 2FA devices.
data_description.agent_token: Token printed by the agent installer.
data_description.repair_users_without_2fa: Creates a repair issue when active users have no second factor (requires the agent).

error.agent_invalid: Unexpected response (wrong URL, incompatible agent version or database error).
error.agent_token_missing: Token required when an agent URL is set.

agent_auth_failed.title: Authelia agent rejects the token
agent_auth_failed.description:
The database agent of **{title}** rejected the configured token. Bans, login history, users and configuration are not updated.

Check the token on the Authelia host with `grep AGENT_TOKEN /etc/authelia-ha-agent/agent.env` and update it under **Settings → Devices & services → Authelia → Configure**.

users_without_2fa.title: Authelia users without second factor
users_without_2fa.description:
These active users of **{title}** have neither TOTP, WebAuthn nor Duo registered: **{users}**.

They can only access resources with a `one_factor` policy, or they can register a second factor on first access to a `two_factor` resource – anyone who knows the password could do so. Register a second factor for these users.

You can disable this warning in the integration options.

legacy_password_hash.title: Authelia users with legacy password hash
legacy_password_hash.description:
These users of **{title}** use a password hash algorithm that is no longer recommended: **{users}**.

Generate a new hash with `authelia crypto hash generate argon2` and replace it in the users database.

default_policy_not_deny.title: Authelia default policy is not deny
default_policy_not_deny.description:
The `access_control.default_policy` of **{title}** is `{policy}`. Requests that match no rule are therefore not denied.

Set `default_policy: 'deny'` and allow access explicitly with rules.

webauthn_clone_warning.title: Possible cloned WebAuthn credential
webauthn_clone_warning.description:
Authelia flagged these WebAuthn credentials of **{title}** because their signature counter went backwards: **{credentials}**.

This can indicate a cloned security key. Verify the device with its owner, remove the credential in Authelia and register it again.
